in_scope: US-0028 security reviewer agent definition (security.mdc) per DEC-0012
/security-review command with design review and code review modes
GDPR compliance profile with concrete checklist items
Workflow integration in /auto (conditional spawn) and /qa (critical check)
security-review.md report placeholder with finding format
Critical findings → DEC-xxxx decision record escalation
Template parity for 6 template files (3 new + 3 modified)
out_of_scope: Detailed checklists for SOC2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, ISO27001 (high-level only; GDPR is reference)

risks: Security agent scope creep — constrained to architectural/pattern-level review by agent definition rules
False sense of security from compliance profiles — output explicitly disclaims certification, recommends human review
Critical findings blocking workflow unnecessarily — user can accept risk with documented rationale via decision gate
Zero-overhead guarantee — all integration points conditional on SECURITY_REVIEW=1, default is 0
Template parity across 6 files — single task (T-009) after all active changes complete
Compliance profiles are prompt-embedded, not validated — quality improves over time as prompts are refined
